en: Illustrated maritime scene showing an icebreaker ship named "MURTAJA" steaming through sea ice, with dark smoke rising from its funnels. The vessel flies a white flag with a blue Nordic cross and a small emblem, strongly resembling a Finnish naval or maritime flag. In the foreground, two sailors stand on the deck of another ship, watching the icebreaker cut a path through the frozen water. The style and printing suggest an early 20th‑century postcard.
